newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chips drop on fears of higher interest rates.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chips drop on fears of higher interest rates.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks dropped sharply Wednesday, shaken by a sell-off in bonds sparked by fears that interest rates may be headed higher and worries about corporate earnings.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended down 70.73 points, or 1.09 percent, at 6,402.52 after trading briefly with a loss of nearly 130 points.
In the broader market, declining issues swamped advances 4-1 on active volume of 497 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
